verification_categories_derived_from_spe: Power-up + initialization — supply ramp ordering (VDD1/VDD2H/VDD2L/VDDQ=0.5 V) + RESET_n + CK start + mode-register program + ZQ calibration + initial WCK2CK synchronization + read/write training.
Reset — RESET_n active-low; full init re-run.

Command-encoding coverage — every command in the LPDDR5 CA encoding table (NOP, PDE, RDFIFO, WRFIFO, RDCAL, MPC, MRW-1/2, MRR, SRE, SRX, REF, PRE, CAS, WR/WR32/MWR, RD/RD32, ACT-1, ACT-2) across two CA transfers (rising + falling CK).
WCK2CK synchronization — WS_FS (free-start, multiple following accesses), WS_RD (read-optimized), WS_WR (write-optimized); verify internal WCK locks to CK before transfers.
Activate — ACT-1 then ACT-2 opens a row; tRCD before first column command.
Read — CAS(WS_RD) → RD / RD32 at programmed RL; RDQS edge-aligned; BL16 / BL32; RD32 starting position via C0/B3; read link ECC + DBI.
Write — CAS(WS_WR) → WR / WR32 / MWR at programmed WL (Set A / Set B); WCK-framed DQ + DMI; write link ECC + DBI.
Write-X (WRX) — burst filled all-zero (WXS=0) / all-one (WXS=1) without data transfer.
Masked Write (MWR) — DMI as per-byte data mask.
Bank-group timing — tCCD_L / tRRD_L same-group vs tCCD_S / tRRD_S different-group; tFAW.
Refresh — REFab (tRFCab), REFpb (round-robin, tRFCpb, other-bank access); tREFI per temperature range; RFM / Adaptive Refresh Management (5B).
Self-refresh entry/exit via CA command (no CKE); mode lasts until CS next goes high.
Deep Sleep Mode (DSE) — entry; full re-init on exit.
DVFS / DVFSC — frequency-set-point switch; WCK rate change; RL/WL/ODT/Vref retraining; VDD2H/VDD2L scaling.
Link ECC — Read/Write single-bit correction; configuration-mismatch detection.
DBI — reduced driven-bit count on DMI.
Mode register access — MRW (two CA cycles) + MRR; tMRW/tMRD/tMRR.
ZQ calibration — start/latch via MPC against external reference resistor.
Read training — RDCAL / Read FIFO; DQ + RDQS sampling-phase sweep with DFE.
Write training — Write FIFO; WCK write-eye training.
CA-bus timing (setup/hold to CK at double data rate) and DQ timing (setup/hold to WCK).
Differential CK / WCK / RDQS swing + crossing-point verification.
Low-voltage IO compliance at VDDQ = 0.5 V; Vref(ca)/Vref(dq) per FSP.
IDD measurements across the per-state current points (active / standby / power-down / self-refresh / deep-sleep).
Two-deck / two-channel organization coverage; per-channel independence.
fields.notes: JESD209-5 does not include a formal verification plan or testbench; the categories above are derived from the command-encoding, mode-register, clocking-architecture, state-machine, and AC-timing sections. The LPDDR5 component compliance test plan is maintained separately by JEDEC and DRAM vendors; vendor LPDDR5 PHY IP also ships with its own verification suite including WCK2CK leveling, DFE training, and link-ECC checks.
